description: This file contains test code for the 'host_orchestrator_client' package, specifically for uploading files with multipart requests, handling retries with exponential backoff, and creating CVD resources via API calls. It includes multiple test functions verifying functionality and error handling.

methods.name: TestUploadFileChunkSizeBytesIsZeroPanic
methods.description: Tests that uploading a file with chunk size zero causes a panic.

methods.name: TestUploadFileSucceeds
methods.description: Verifies that file uploads succeed using multipart uploads with chunks, validating content correctness.

methods.name: TestUploadFileExponentialBackoff
methods.description: Checks that retries use exponential backoff delay times during uploads.

methods.name: TestUploadFileExponentialBackoffReachedElapsedTime
methods.description: Ensures that retries stop after exceeding maximum elapsed time.

methods.name: TestCreateCVD
methods.description: Tests creating a CVD resource and waits for the operation to complete, verifying the response.

methods.name: TestCreateCVDWithUserProjectOverride
methods.description: Tests creating a CVD with custom user project ID and access token, verifying headers.

methods.name: createTempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory for test use.

methods.name: createTempFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with specified content for testing.

methods.name: writeErr
methods.description: Helper function to send an error response.

methods.name: writeOK
methods.description: Helper function to send a successful JSON response.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Generic writer to serialize data to HTTP response with specified status.
